In Switzerland, in a large conference room, representatives from nations sit. No news of the meeting will reach the outside world, and delegates will stagger their entrance and exit times as to avoid being noticed together. Inside, representatives from Liberland, San Marino, and Sealand discuss politics. Before long, Michael Bates stands up. "Gentlemen, a crossroads stands before us. To the left is prosperity, to the right is ruin. Today we choose which path to take, and today we will forge a new pact that will unify all micronations under a single heraldry: XCOM. Now, the first order of business: we need a constitution of sorts. Ideas?"
[M] My mind went straight to this when I read that title.

The door to the conference room swings open.

Soon two men enter, one of them is a younger man holding a briefcase which is quickly wrote off as a assistant, as while the other one everyone recognizes from the Micronation conference a few months ago: Prince Hans-Adams II.

The two men walk and then sit down at an open spot at the table.

“Sorry for the delay Gentlemen, I had some issues I needed to address back in the homeland. Let me restate my goal for being here. I am already a sovereign nation at which people respect. My goal is to make your nations truly sovereign and independent to be recognized on the world stage. With that being said I am standing as an advisor to your council and to support you in your struggles.”

“As a respected member of the international community I have a lot of media attention that follows me. We can use that as a springboard for your nations to become recognized.”

“In addition to that I would like to establish diplomats and embassies in each of your nations if you so choose and if your nation has room for my embassy.”

“Why am I willing to help some of you might wonder? Why would I risk so much to help you all become independent? That is easy my friends. I believe in self-rule. No one knows what is better for you, then yourself. If you feel you can successfully establish your own nations and is willing to go the distance, I will support you.”

“So Gentlemen I ask you a simple question. Who wants to change the world?”

Michael Bates replies. "I move to introduce a resolution: Find a new hiding place. Seconded? Excellent. Motion passed. Well, Prince Hans, we of XCOM welcome you into our humble union. We too want to change the world - one nation at a time. Perhaps some of the larger nations would do better split up into many smaller states - African nations not drawn along ethnic lines, Middle Eastern ones divided by religion… Much could be done with a simple redrawing of borders."

"Thank you Mr. Bates" The Prince replies. "If XCOM would care to move to the confides of Liechtenstein we would be more then willing to set up a permanent Headquarters there for our organization in the city of Vaduz. This would protect our organization from spies and other foreigners who would care to hurt our intentions as you would be meeting in a friendly sovereign nation."
"That would be greatly appreciated and I believe the other member nations will agree greatly."

The Prince tells his assistant Otto to find a good location for the new XCOM HQ. "I expect it to be done by early December." Said the Prince. "All meetings next year shall be held there. What is our current meeting schedule? Once a quarter?"
"I imagine we can have two major biannual meetings. Any more than that can be called as needed."
"Make a note of that Otto. If any inside of XCOM would like to send Diplomats or ambassador to the Principality we could easily set up embassies as well. "
